local_segment_diagnostics.aggregation: Unweighted across local segments; diagnostic only, excluded from the clip-weighted composite

rubric.scale: Integer 0–5: 0 unusable/wrong; 1 major errors; 2 partly supported; 3 useful with notable errors; 4 accurate with minor errors; 5 fully correct and useful

definitions.global_caption_fidelity: Does GENERAL describe the audible voice, performance and environment accurately, without invented demographic/identity/psychological claims?
definitions.global_emotion_fit: Are the whole-utterance emotion descriptions supported by audible affect, including intensity and changes? Important omissions reduce usefulness; restrained descriptions are appropriate when affect is ambiguous.
definitions.sentence_emotion_fit: Do emotion cues fit their particular spoken segments and intensity? Consider both false emotion tags and important missing affect. No emotion tag is not a claim of neutrality: do not penalize appropriate restraint on ambiguous segments.
definitions.utterance_talking_style_fit: Do GENERAL's speaking-style claims match audible tempo, articulation, breathiness, pitch movement, register, emphasis and performance style?
definitions.sentence_delivery_fit: Do local delivery/voice tags fit the corresponding spoken segment rather than merely repeating a global trait?
definitions.burst_description_fit: Does each free-form burst caption match the actual nonverbal vocal sound in its selected interval? Reward acoustic accuracy, not verbosity.
definitions.burst_timing_fit: Do absolute event starts/ends cover the audible events without unnecessary unrelated speech?
definitions.event_precision: Are proposed intervals real nonverbal vocal events rather than spoken syllables or spurious detections? This is a reviewer rating, not measured detection precision.
definitions.event_coverage: Are salient audible nonverbal events covered? This is a reviewer rating, not measured detection recall.
definitions.transcript_fidelity: Does the recognized word sequence match what is heard? This is diagnostic, not part of the weighted composite.
definitions.speech_timing_fit: Do speech budgets and pause intervals fit the audio? This is diagnostic, separate from mechanical formatting validation.
definitions.readability: Is the annotation understandable, concise and useful? This is diagnostic, not part of the weighted composite.

rubric.aggregation: Equal weight per recording; fixed weights above. Per-segment ratings are diagnostic and do not overweight recordings with more sentences.
rubric.empty_event_policy: If no event is audible and none is proposed, event ratings are 5. False proposals or omitted audible events reduce the corresponding ratings.
rubric.important_limitations: Single automated reviewer; 50 reused synthetic acting recordings, 45 English/5 German; no human reference labels, no inter-rater agreement. New rubric is not comparable numerically to the older MOSS/procedural composite. No settings are optimized using these new ratings.

bootstrap: 10,000 clip resamples, seed 20261011; excludes reviewer bias and domain shift
